title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 20
text:
Excess
Some policies include an excess, which appears after the policy limit in 
the slip.
If the slip says “Excess of deductibles set forth below” , and the 
deductibles are listed in another section, then use the deductible rules 
explained in Deductible slides.
Enter the excess amount in the UNDCOVAMT column of the ACC file.
Aggregate excess cannot be modeled in RMS RiskLink however 
possible in RM.
If a large deductible is called “self-insured retention” and is mentioned 
separately , treat it as an excess.
